supporting_observations.claim: At 14:16:09 UTC, Explorer set a UserAssist registry value for Ivy Chen whose encoded path decodes to C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe. This is consistent with PowerShell having been launched, but the record does not provide a command line or establish when the launch occurred.
Around the reported 13:40 time, proxy records show Ivy Chen's Chrome browser accessing login.salesforce.com and its associated page resources; these records do not identify PowerShell activity.

At 13:26 UTC, the proxy recorded a CONNECT to desktop.dropbox.com with a DropboxUpdate user agent. Dropbox is not an approved file-sharing service in the supplied environment context, but this record alone does not establish file synchronization, data transfer, or malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include a PowerShell process-creation event or command line, so the PowerShell activity and its purpose cannot be determined from this evidence.
The UserAssist registry write is recorded at 14:16:09 UTC, not around 13:40; it does not establish that the reported brief window occurred at that time.
The evidence is a selected set of records and does not establish that all relevant endpoint, authentication, or network events are present.
claims_not_established: That PowerShell was launched at approximately 13:40 UTC.
What command, script, or other content PowerShell may have run, or whether the activity was authorized.
That the Dropbox-related proxy connection involved file sharing or data exfiltration.
That the reported window was caused by malicious activity or by benign IT activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Endpoint process-creation telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 covering the review period, including PowerShell command lines, parent process, user, and script-block or module logging if available.
Relevant PowerShell operational logs and console or script history, with care to preserve evidence.
The full UserAssist registry value data and associated timestamps, plus corroborating endpoint telemetry to establish when PowerShell was launched.
IT patching records and remote-administration logs for WS-ICHEN-01 around the alert time.
Endpoint and proxy records for the Dropbox updater connection, including process attribution and any associated upload or download activity.
